These edits remove absolute positional embeddings, their initialization and padding-row zeroing, and the position calculations used by encode_sequence. Inputs now contain only scaled item embeddings; causal dilated convolutions retain order and relative-distance information.

All eight independent blocks, dilation schedule, learned residual scales, masking, normalization, activation, dropout, item initialization, tied scoring, last-nonpadding candidate selection, interfaces, imports, and hyperparameters remain unchanged. This defines one ablation for frozen-host validation against the supplied HR@10 of 0.65. The 0.66 target represents two additional hits among 200 validation users; no new result is claimed.
